title: Long-time asymptotics of the heat kernel on a homogeneous tree
author: Effie Papageorgiou
work: Long-time asymptotics for the heat kernel and for heat equation solutions on homogeneous trees
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the article's Theorem 4.2 (source label 'prop:heat_asymp_ell1'), the paper's headline asymptotic result: on a homogeneous tree the heat kernel satisfies, in the joint regime where the distance of the point tends to infinity and the time tends to infinity, an explicit asymptotic formula in which the tree kernel is expressed through the heat kernel of the integers, with the correction factor H built from the auxiliary function eta and the growth parameter gamma(0) of the tree. The unit is above ordinary PhD qualifying level because the counted proof is a complete fifty-line asymptotic argument rather than a citation: it starts from the integral representation of the tree heat kernel as a contour integral of the generating function, rewrites the kernel in terms of the integer heat kernel through the spectral decomposition of the tree, estimates the remaining contour integral uniformly in the joint regime, and identifies the limiting correction factor H together with the error terms. Obtaining a uniform asymptotic expansion in two simultaneous parameters on a non-amenable geometry is research-level analysis rather than a qualifying-examination exercise.
